caption: The drawing depicts three views of a rectangular, decorative object with an articulated central section, likely a buckle or clasp. The object is outlined in black with geometric and curving lines. The topmost view is rendered in color: it features a silver or metallic-gray outer frame with black accents and brown shading around the inner edges, and includes two hinges at its top and bottom. Inside the frame are curving and straight bars that create an abstract, symmetrical pattern, with a central element that appears to be a stylized cut-out motif. Below the colored view are two line drawings, one showing a similar front or back view and the other presenting a side profile of the object. All three are set against a cream or light tan background.
title: Shoe Buckle
